This was, at one point, a rather popular card.. thanks to it's 100mW / 200mW :power output and high receiver sensitivity. It was also sold (and may be more common) as the ''EnGenius NL-2511CD PLUS EXT2''.
Additional specifications, per ''[[Senao]]'''s datasheet (mirrored here), follow...
